footprints.description: Focus C204A-BW 20x4 LCD module, 98.0 x 60.0 mm, one 1x16 row along the top (pins 1..16), 4 mounting holes
footprints.note: Focus drawing, module-disp-char/C204A-BW-LW25_Spec.pdf p.4: PCB 98+-0.5 x 60+-0.3 (mid 98 x 60); 16 pins at P2.54*15=38.1, pin 1 at 10 from the left edge, row 2.5 below the top edge, pins 1..16 left to right; holes 4 x R1.25 (d2.5) at 93 x 55, 2.5 from the edges. Pin drill not printed: d1.0 assumed, as on the other Focus sheets. The drawing gives no pad sizes: pin pads d1.8 (pin 1 square) and hole pads drill + 2.5, plan-11-C's module rule (d2.5 -> d5.0)
